title: Yellow Earthy Saudi Arabian Lentil Stew
description: A comforting and earthy Saudi Arabian dish featuring caramelized onions and dried red chillies, perfect for a chilly evening. This plant-based-friendly stew is a hearty and flavorful option for any meal.

ingredients.name: dried red chillies
ingredients.notes: crushed or 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the crushed dried red chillies, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, tomato paste, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
